label: friction after
goal: Buy one Trail Backpack with standard delivery. Your details: full name Alex Morgan, email alex.morgan@example.com, street address 100 Example Avenue, city Testville, ZIP 99999, country United States. Pay by card: name on card Alex Morgan, card number 4111 1111 1111 1111, expiry 12/30, security code 123. Agree to the terms of sale. You do not want newsletters or promotions.

outcome.reason: The order is confirmed by the payment oracle.

findings.page: Your cart - Pine and Peak Outfitters
findings.problem: A newsletter popup opened by itself and grabbed keyboard focus (the close button); a user must notice and close it before continuing
After pressing Add, the only feedback is a status text; focus stays on the button and the Cart link is far back at the top, so I had to wrap around the whole page with Tab to reach the Cart
No direct Checkout link on the product page and 25 category links before the content on every page; the skip link helps but the cart link sits before the category list only by luck of order

The PayPal button is a div with no accessible name and no role (just PayPal); the card fields in the embedded frame have only placeholder-style labels such as MM / YY and CVV and the card section is not announced as a group
After pressing Pay nothing visibly changed and focus stayed on the button; I had to read again to find that the order was done, with no progress or status announcement

findings.page: Your cart - Pine and Peak Outfitters
findings.problem: A newsletter popup opened by itself and grabbed keyboard focus (the close button); a user must notice and close it before continuing
After pressing Add, the only feedback is a status text; focus stays on the button and the Cart link is far back at the top, so I had to wrap around the whole page with Tab to reach the Cart
No direct Checkout link on the product page and 25 category links before the content on every page; the skip link helps but the cart link sits before the category list only by luck of order

The PayPal button is a div with no accessible name and no role (just PayPal); the card fields in the embedded frame have only placeholder-style labels such as MM / YY and CVV and the card section is not announced as a group
After pressing Pay nothing visibly changed and focus stayed on the button; I had to read again to find that the order was done, with no progress or status announcement
